rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose noun for general bad luck.

example.english: I've really had bad luck lately; misfortune keeps finding me.
example.traditional: 我近排真係黑仔，成日撞衰運。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gan6 paai4 zan1 hai6 hak1 zai2 seng4 jat6 zong6 seoi1 wan6

rows.note: Use this more formal noun for misfortune in general, including a specific unfortunate event.

example.english: This misfortune dealt a heavy blow to the whole family.
example.traditional: 呢宗不幸對成個家庭都造成沉重打擊。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung1 bat1 hang6 deoi3 sing4 go3 gaa1 ting4 dou1 zou6 sing4 cam4 zung6 daa2 gik1

rows.note: Use this for a misfortune that is an accident or other unexpected incident.

example.english: That accident broke his leg; it was a real misfortune.
example.traditional: 嗰場意外搞到佢隻腳骨折，真係好唔好彩。
example.jyutping: go2 coeng4 ji3 ngoi6 gaau2 dou3 keoi5 zek3 goek3 gwat1 zit3 zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 hou2 coi2
